subject: Request: Chain-of-custody snapshots & escape-hatch for tenant erasure - FirstBank SOC2 RFI
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@firstbank.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@firstbank.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: chain-of-custody snapshots and erasure artifacts for tenant 'firstbank-prod-42'

Hi Aisha,

We are preparing for our SOC 2 readiness review and need to collect evidence tied to your retention/deletion controls for the tenant firstbank-prod-42. Specifically we need:

- Timestamped deletion execution logs (start/end + per-tenant record counts) for the requested erase executed 2026-02-11 UTC.
- Chain-of-custody snapshots showing where tenant data lived (regions/geozones) at the time of retention expiration.
- Confirmation of any KMS/HSM key rotation or escrow actions taken as part of the erasure.
- Sampling artifacts/proof that deletion produces consistent deterministic traces (small CSV sample + hash).
- A short description of your sampling and attestation methodology (how you prove erasure for audited tenants).

We'd like these artifacts uploaded to the shared evidence folder by EOD 2026-02-18. If you have a standard deliverable pack for SOC 2 / ISO retention + erasure, please point us to it.

Thanks,

Sara Liu
Senior Compliance Manager
FirstBank -- InfoSec & Compliance
[FirstBank compliance portal: compliance.firstbank.com]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@firstbank.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: chain-of-custody snapshots and erasure artifacts for tenant 'firstbank-prod-42'

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. High-level plan:

1) Neha will pull the deletion execution logs and a small CSV sampling artifact (hashed) for firstbank-prod-42.
2) Vivek will provide a one-paragraph KMS/HSM attestation and any key rotation notes tied to the erase window.
3) Priyom will attach the residency map and an explanation of the sampling/attestation methodology we use for SOC 2 / ISO scopes.

We expect to upload the requested artifacts to your Drive folder by 2026-02-12 COB Pacific. If anything in your list is binding (e.g., specific hash algorithm or proof format), let us know — otherwise we'll include SHA-256 hashes and a manifest CSV with row-level counts.

Aisha Rahman
Manager, Customer Compliance & Solutions
Redwood Inference
[mobile redacted]

--

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Fwd: Request: chain-of-custody snapshots and erasure artifacts for tenant 'firstbank-prod-42'

Folks — forwarding FirstBank's RFI. Target deliverable: artifacts uploaded to shared Drive and confirmation email back to Sara by EOD Thu 2026-02-12 Pacific. Short asks below; reply here with ETA.

Neha: pull the erase execution logs from the runtime cluster for 2026-02-11 (UTC). Include per-shard start/end times and counts, plus a small sampled CSV (<=500 rows) with SHA-256 hashes for each row. Name: deletion_manifest_2026-02-11.csv.

Vivek: provide a 2–3 sentence KMS/HSM attestation (did any keys rotate, were any keys revoked/escrowed for this tenant around the erasure window?). If there's a signed cert or HSM log snippet we can include, add it to the tarball.

Priyom: export the residency map (residency_map_v3.pdf) that shows where data was stored historically and at deletion time; include short methodology blurb for sampling/attestation for SOC 2 & ISO (control references: CC6, CC7, ISO 27001 A.12.3). Also include the runbook excerpt that describes the 'escape-hatch' (manual verification steps) if automation cannot complete.

If anyone anticipates a delay, call me — otherwise please upload to the folder linked below and reply-all once done.

Drive link (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EXAMPLE-FirstBank-evidence
Jira: SEC-1172 (tracking evidence deliverable)

Thanks,
Aisha

Hi Sara / Compliance team — attaching the deliverable pack we discussed. Summary below and files are in the shared Drive folder. If you prefer we can run through this in a 30-minute walkthrough; available tomorrow 09:00-12:00 PT.

What we uploaded (files attached / links):
- deletion_manifest_2026-02-11.csv (manifest): per-record counts, per-shard start/end times, SHA-256 sample hashes (sample size = 350 rows).
- erase_execution_logs_20260211.tar.gz: raw runtime logs (compressed). Contains shard-level timestamps and process exit codes.
- residency_map_v3.pdf: geozone map and residency timeline for firstbank-prod-42 covering the retention window + deletion timestamp.
- runbook_excerpt_sampling.pdf: excerpt of the runbook describing sampling and attestation steps, plus the manual verification 'escape-hatch'.

Short answers to your bullets:
- Deletion timestamps: manifest includes UTC start (2026-02-11T03:14:21Z) and end (2026-02-11T03:18:06Z) and per-shard deltas.
- Chain-of-custody/residency: residency_map_v3.pdf shows the tenant's primary storage in us-west1 with ephemeral caches in eu-west1 during a migration window; all locations and retention segments are annotated.
- KMS/HSM: No key rotation occurred during the deletion window. Vivek attached HSM operation log snippet and provided a short signed attestation.
- Sampling/proof: we use deterministic hashing (SHA-256) over canonicalized rows; manifest includes sample rows + hashes plus a short methodology paragraph and the audit checklist reference (SOC 2 CC6.4 equivalence).

Attachments: deletion_manifest_2026-02-11.csv (CSV), residency_map_v3.pdf (PDF), erase_execution_logs_20260211.tar.gz (TAR.GZ), runbook_excerpt_sampling.pdf (PDF).

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EXAMPLE-FirstBank-evidence
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1172

If you need a notarized or signed attestation for your audit package, we can route this through our legal/compliance team — happy to do that if required.
